**Finding: compliant (preferred position met) — no redline proposed.**

- **§ 2(a) (p0022)** grants Client a *non-exclusive* licence and expressly confirms Client "is not obligated to utilize the License and is free to acquire, develop, license or otherwise utilize any other hardware, software system... to provide software and services similar to the ones provided by TrueLink."
- **§ 3(i) (p0042)** requires a TrueLink credit report only where Client chooses to seek underwriting approval "through a System using the Interface" — a conditional sourcing term tied to voluntary use of Vendor's interface, not exclusivity, given the express freedom to use alternatives.
- **§ 8(d) (p0054)** grants TrueLink only a *nonexclusive* Credit Data licence, subject to a Non-Competition Agreement that constrains TrueLink; any exclusivity there runs in our favour and is not flagged.
- Sections 5, 7, 10 and 12 contain no requirements-purchase, sole-host, or "shall not procure from any third party" covenant.
